description: Annual regional train station patronage (station entries) is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Total annual patronage (station entries) for Victorian regional train stations, to allow users to analyse Victorian regional train patronage by station, day type, time of day and total annual. Data Quality Patronage estimates are rounded to nearest 50 and values less than 50 are rounded up to 50\. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are boardings, patronage, public transport, ridership, station. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
